0=不做任何驗證；1=驗證伺服器（需先把受信任 CA 憑證放進模組 UFS）；2: 0 = no verification at all; 1 = verify the server (the trusted CA certificate must be placed in the module's UFS first); 2 = mutual server + client verification (a client cert and private key are also needed when the remote end demands them). Manual §4 says outright: with seclevel 1 or 2 the certificates must be uploaded to the module first — use the Upload button in the "UFS Files" group below (from V26.0.83 on, binary files work too; the verification flow was confirmed end-to-end on real hardware, 2026-08-07 P5). ⚠ Also note that sni ships as 0: a server hosting several domains on one IP (badssl.com is one) hands back a mismatched certificate when no SNI is sent, and verification is guaranteed to fail with 566.
手冊 §3.2 範例為 UFS:cacert.pem。這條只是「指路」—— 檔案: The manual's §3.2 example is UFS:cacert.pem. This command only "points the way" — first upload the file itself with the Upload button in the "UFS Files" group below (the button exists as of V26.0.83), then use this command to point the context at it.
模組內建的快閃儲存（User File Storage）。憑證要先上傳到這裡，上: The module's built-in flash storage (User File Storage). Certificates must be uploaded here first, or the cacert setting above has no file to point at. Uploads run over UART with zero data traffic; binary files work too.
把電腦上的檔案上傳到模組 UFS。兩段式：等 CONNECT 後送原始位元組；大: Upload a file from this computer to the module's UFS. Two-stage: wait for CONNECT, then send the raw bytes; the size and checksum are computed automatically, and on completion the annotation automatically compares them against the values +QFUPL reports — a mismatch means the transfer went bad
The name the file is stored under in the module. Picking a file fills in the original name automatically (editable); SSL certificate convention: cacert.pem / clientcert.pem / clientkey.pem
大小 bytes（選檔自動填）: Size in bytes (auto-filled on file pick)
選檔後自動填入，不要手動改 —— 與實際位元組數不符時，模組會等到逾時、以不完整: Auto-filled after picking a file — do not edit it by hand. If it disagrees with the actual byte count, the module waits out the timeout and stores the file with incomplete content
模組等資料的上限（手冊預設 5，本卡帶 10 較保險）。逾時會把已收到的內容存檔: The upper limit on how long the module waits for data (manual default 5; this card ships with 10, the safer choice). On timeout it stores whatever has arrived and reports back — if you see a size mismatch, delete the file and upload again
列出 UFS 全部檔案與大小 —— 上傳後用這條驗證檔案在不在、大小對不對（零流: List every file in UFS with its size — use it after an upload to verify the file is there and the size is right (no traffic)
查 UFS 剩餘／總空間 bytes（零流量）: Query the free / total UFS space in bytes (no traffic)
會刪除模組 UFS 裡的檔案，不可復原（填 * 是刪全部）: Deletes files in the module's UFS, irreversibly (entering * deletes everything)
刪除 UFS 裡的指定檔案；上傳壞掉時先刪再傳: Delete the named file in UFS; when an upload goes bad, delete first, then upload again
要刪的檔名；* 代表全部檔案: The file name to delete; * means all files
會寫入遠端伺服器。收到 CONNECT 後必須以 raw 位元組送出「剛好 le: Writes to the remote server. After CONNECT arrives you must send "exactly len bytes" as raw bytes, with no CR/LF appended. This button is paste-plain-text only; for binary files take the other route: the Upload button in the "UFS Files" group on the SSL page puts the file into UFS → AT+QFTPPUT="UFS:filename" relays the upload (FILE manual §3.6). Plain text (control characters can be escaped as \n \r \xHH).
上傳檔案到模組 UFS（兩段式）：等 CONNECT 後送「剛好宣告長度」的原始: Upload a file to the module's UFS (two-stage): wait for CONNECT, then send raw bytes of "exactly the declared length". Zero data traffic — UFS is storage inside the module and nothing goes over the network
列出 UFS 檔案清單（零流量）: List the files in UFS (no traffic)
查 UFS 儲存空間（零流量）: Query the UFS storage space (no traffic)
查 UFS 已用空間與檔案數（零流量）: Query the used UFS space and file count (no traffic)
刪除 UFS 裡的檔案（\"*\"＝全部）；成功只回 OK: Delete files in UFS ("*" = all); success returns only OK
UFS 剩餘 {0} bytes／總容量 {1} bytes: UFS free {0} bytes / total capacity {1} bytes
❌ 與本機檔案不符（預期 {0} bytes／{1}）—— 上傳不完整，請 Q: ❌ Does not match the local file (expected {0} bytes / {1}) — incomplete upload; QFDEL it and upload again
✅ 與本機檔案的大小、checksum 皆吻合（16-bit XOR）: ✅ Size and checksum both match the local file (16-bit XOR)
請先選擇要上傳的檔案: Pick a file to upload first
